text: claims_detail_gold is correct but wide open. This video closes that gap with real Unity Catalog row-level security, restricting every query to a user's own assigned clinic.
Three pieces: a clinic_access_lookup table as the source of truth, a SQL row filter function checking group membership and that lookup, and one statement attaching it to the table.
The function is one short-circuit OR: compliance_team members see all fifteen clinics; everyone else only sees rows matching their own assignment in the lookup table.
ALTER TABLE SET ROW FILTER attaches this directly to claims_detail_gold's metadata -- no dashboard, notebook, or query can bypass it. We verified both sides with real accounts.
The exact exposure Harborview started this project to fix is now closed at the data layer. Next: masking the SSN itself with a Unity Catalog column mask.
